analysis.is_complaint_reason: Customer expresses dissatisfaction with the bank's closure of their current account and alleges financial loss and distress (wages bounced, unable to pay rent), meeting CH-1.
analysis.summary: Customer's current account [ACCOUNT_NUMBER_1] was closed on 29/09/2026 with two days' notice after a financial crime review; closure notice dated 27/09/2026. The customer says their wages bounced and they could not pay rent. They were not told the reasons for the review. They want the account reopened and an explanation. They have consulted a solicitor and say they are speaking to a local journalist, which raises legal and media risk. Note 1 says the review reasons cannot be disclosed to the customer. No vulnerability indicators were recorded and the customer was not asked. Case is a complaint and is routed to Senior Complaints Review because of threatened legal action and media contact, with Fraud & Scams potentially needed given the financial crime review. The handler should confirm the basis of the closure and the review status before any response.

timeline.event: Account [ACCOUNT_NUMBER_1] closed following financial crime review
Customer's wages bounced and customer could not pay rent (customer's account of impact; date MISSING)

analysis.severity_reason: CH-6 High: customer has threatened legal action (has spoken to a solicitor) and has media contact (talking to a journalist). Financial loss is alleged but the amount is not stated, so loss cannot be quantified.

vulnerability.suggested_support: No indicators recorded, but the customer was not asked. Given that rent could not be paid after wages bounced, ask the customer sensitively whether they need any support (VUL-2). Reassess on contact.

analysis.routing_reason: ESC-1: threat of legal action and media contact require Senior Complaints Review. The account was closed following a financial crime review, which may involve suspected fraud or scam, so Fraud & Scams is also needed. Senior Complaints Review is listed first because of the legal and media triggers; the handler should confirm with the Fraud & Scams team whether the review is a fraud matter.
